scripts.dev: npm run spa-build-dev && cross-env NODE_ENV=development nodemon server/standalone.js --watch server
scripts.spa-build-dev: npm --prefix spa install --include=dev && npm --prefix spa run build-dev
scripts.spa-build-prod: npm --prefix spa install --include=dev && npm --prefix spa run build-prod
scripts.deploy: npm install && npm run spa-build-prod && pm2 start
scripts.lint: eslint server && npm --prefix spa run lint
